exposure: Haemolysis, elevated liver enzymes and low platelets (HELLP) syndrome
Presence or absence of hypertension at presentation
cohort: 43 women whose delivery was complicated by HELLP syndrome at The Royal Women's Hospital in Melbourne, Australia
finding: Misdiagnosis and delayed recognition of HELLP syndrome are common due to vague and varying presentation, but when identified, delivery is required to avoid catastrophic maternal and neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Most (79%) women delivered by caesarean section.
